name: 8balls: Pool & Billiards
description:
Make time for your next great shot. 8balls brings 8-ball and 9-ball pool to Android with a clear 3D table, emerald felt and precise touch controls.

Practice at your own pace, play against computer opponents with three difficulty levels, or share one device for a local two-player match.

• Learn the controls with a guided tutorial.
• Adjust your aim, shot power and cue-ball spin.
• Switch between overhead and aiming views.
• Choose a left-handed control layout.
• Large, bold text, big buttons and large ball numbers by default, with a high-contrast option.
• Reduce motion and switch vibration on or off.
• Play offline practice and local matches without an account.

Every match is free. There are no ads or in-app purchases, and cosmetic choices do not improve shot power or accuracy.

Available in English, Hebrew, Arabic, Spanish and Portuguese.

Find your angle. Set your pace. Play 8balls.
